dedupe_keys.name: geospatial energy consumer aggregation and plotting r code

description: The MUSE-RASA research team publishes an R script for analysing global geospatial energy-consumer parameters. The source loads consumer and diagnostic tables, aggregates energy demand and socioeconomic indicators, and produces comparisons across modelling regions. Zenodo provides the script publicly and free under CC BY 4.0. Its documented coverage includes twenty figures and explicitly excludes other analyses because of sponsorship agreements. The routines can help inspect agent parameters and simulation inputs for model-muse-os. A caveat is that this release is an analysis script, not the complete RASA agent-generation model. It uses a local working directory and six expected CSV inputs whose names do not directly match the five-file current data deposit. Users must resolve input mappings and dependencies before execution. No R session or data processing was run.
